Please give us an overview of everything. Please start at the beginning of your life and tell us every time you got into trouble with school or the law. Please also list any infractions in prison. Make sure to include the state and county every arrest was in and if you were convicted or not. Also include any federal convictions. Please also include every job you can remember, how long you worked there, and why you left. This full timeline allows us to convince employers to work with you by being up front with them about your history. We understand you may not remember everything but include everything you can remember so we don't have any surprises later.
